entities.summary: Second Treaty, a significant document in the history of Luxembourg (1839–1890). Part of Grand Duchy & Path to Independence. Shaped Treaty of London establishes Luxembourg's perpetual neutrality and Personal union with the Netherlands ends; Grand Duchy fully independent.
